nodes.name: Claim due messages
nodes.notes: Atomic: scheduled -> processing. A second concurrent execution receives the rows this one did NOT take, so a message is never handed out twice.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', recipient_type: 'individual', to: $json.phone, type: 'template', template: { name: $json.template_name, language: { code: $json.template_language }, components: Object.keys($json.template_variables || {}).length ? [{ type: 'body', parameters: Object.keys($json.template_variables).sort((a,b) => Number(a) - Number(b)).map(k => ({ type: 'text', text: String($json.template_variables[k]) })) }] : undefined } }) }}

nodes.name: Send template
nodes.notes: neverError + fullResponse so a 4xx/5xx flows into the router instead of aborting the item. NEVER enable retryOnFail here: a retry could deliver the message twice.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', recipient_type: 'individual', to: $json.phone, type: 'text', text: { preview_url: false, body: $json.body } }) }}

nodes.name: Send text
nodes.notes: Same rules as Send template: never retry an outbound send.

nodes.name: Report sent
nodes.notes: Safe to retry: the app keys this on the claim token, so a repeated confirmation is a no-op.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message_id: $json.message_id, claim_token: $json.claim_token, error_code: $json.error_code, error_message: $json.error_message, retryable: $json.retryable }) }}

nodes.name: Report failed
nodes.notes: The APP decides whether another attempt happens — n8n only reports the error. That keeps the retry budget in one place.

meta.description: Claims due messages from Abominable Messaging, sends them through the official WhatsApp Business Cloud API and reports the outcome back. All credentials come from n8n environment variables — no secrets are stored in this file.
